ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the upper part of the figure is a sulfonamide/carbamate salt structure, with MeO2C–N on the left carrying a negative charge and connected to S, S having two S=O, connected on the right to NEt3 and this nitrogen carrying a positive charge; there are curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring them. Below is an organic fragment containing two adjacent chiral carbons, and the two chiral carbons are respectively connected to phenyl groups; one end shows HO, H, and Ph, and the other end shows D, H, and Ph, with bond lines using wedge/dashed lines to indicate stereochemical configuration. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, the upper independent salt structure is expanded as specified to CC[N+](CC)(CC)S(=O)(=O)[N-]C(=O)OC. The lower fragment is written according to two adjacent chiral centers, phenyl is written as c1ccccc1, the second chiral center is connected to OH, the first chiral center is connected to an asterisk/dummy atom, and according to the wedge/dashed lines in the figure two [C@H] are given, obtaining *[C@H](c1ccccc1)[C@H](O)c1ccccc1. The two parts are independent of each other, so they are connected with a period.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Read the image as a chemical structure, ignoring all curved arrows. Expand the upper sulfamoyl carbamate salt into CC[N+](CC)(CC)S(=O)(=O)[N-]C(=O)OC. Then encode the lower stereochemical organic fragment by following the carbon chain through the two adjacent stereocenters, adding phenyl substituents as c1ccccc1, the OH substituent on the second stereocenter, and the dummy/star substituent on the first stereocenter as drawn; assign the wedge/dash configuration to give *[C@H](c1ccccc1)[C@H](O)c1ccccc1. Join the two independent components with a period to obtain *[C@H](c1ccccc1)[C@H](O)c1ccccc1.CC[N+](CC)(CC)S(=O)(=O)[N-]C(=O)OC.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中上方是一个磺酰胺/氨基甲酸酯盐结构，左侧为 MeO2C–N 带负电并连接到 S，S 上有两个 S=O，右侧连接 NEt3 且该氮带正电；图中有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略。下方是一个含两个相邻手性碳的有机片段，两个手性碳分别连有苯基；一端显示 HO、H 和 Ph，另一端显示 D、H 和 Ph，键线用楔形/虚线表示立体构型。推理：忽略箭头后，上方独立盐结构按指定展开为 CC[N+](CC)(CC)S(=O)(=O)[N-]C(=O)OC。下方片段按两个相邻手性中心书写，苯基写作 c1ccccc1，第二个手性中心连 OH，第一个手性中心连星号/哑原子，并根据图中楔虚线给出两个 [C@H]，得到 *[C@H](c1ccccc1)[C@H](O)c1ccccc1。两部分彼此独立，因此用句点连接。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-to-SMILES transcription is the natural and essentially single route for this problem; it relies on reading the displayed bonds, stereochemical wedges/dashes, charges, and substituent abbreviations, then encoding them in SMILES.
planner_metadata.image_role: Inspect the image first: identify two disconnected components separated by a dot. The upper component is MeO2C–N(−)–S(=O)2–N(+)(Et)3 with the curved arrows ignored. The lower component is a vicinal diphenyl alcohol/deuterated center drawn with stereochemical wedge/dash bonds: HO on one stereocenter, phenyl groups on both carbons, and the right stereocenter bearing D/H; the requested answer encodes the marked/deuterated site as a dummy atom attachment and preserves the two chiral centers.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the desired output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that the arrows should be ignored; no additional textual data are needed.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard organic abbreviation expansion: MeO2C = C(=O)OC attached through N, NEt3 = N(CC)(CC)CC, phenyl = c1ccccc1. Use SMILES conventions for disconnected species with '.', formal charges as [N-] and [N+], sulfone as S(=O)(=O), and tetrahedral stereochemistry as [C@H]/[C@@H] chosen to match the wedges/dashes in the drawing.
